reasoning_content: The actual http.server PIDs are 14033 (port 8123, the one I forgot to kill) and 14048 (port 8000). Kill them by the exact PIDs. Also, a `my_api_key` file was created in /workspace by the test suite (created by the tests — tearDown only deletes it when os.path.exists("my_api_key")... actually tearDown deletes my_api_key). Let me verify: `DcatCatalogCheck("http://test.invalid:8000/", "my_api_key")` — the second argument is the log_file parameter? Looking at __init__(self, client_site_url, log_file=None, ...). So the tests are passing "my_api_key" as the log file. tearDown deletes my_api_key if it exists. But git status is showing ?? my_api_key — probably from a test that writes to it... Let me check the file and delete it since it's a test artifact in the workspace.

action.command: kill 14033 14048 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ps aux | grep -c "[h]ttp.server"; ls -la /workspace/my_api_key 2>&1; cat /workspace/my_api_key 2>/dev/null | head -3
